title: International student visa overview
answer: International students need a student pass (eVAL/VAL) via the university and EMGS. New students apply before entry; renewals require CGPA 2.0+, 80% attendance, and passport valid 18+ months. Contact ISS (iss@swinburne.edu.my) for applications and documents.

title: New international student visa
answer: New international students must apply for a student pass through the university and EMGS, obtain eVAL/VAL, and should not enter Malaysia on a tourist visa for study.

title: Documents for student pass
answer: Key documents: passport-size photo (white background), copies of all passport pages, passport valid at least 18 months, offer letter, academic records, pre-VAL medical report, plus country-specific documents if applicable.

title: Transfer from another institution
answer: Transfer students inside Malaysia must cancel the previous institution's pass and obtain a Release Letter before applying for a new eVAL/VAL with Swinburne.

title: Student visa renewal
answer: Renew around 3 months before expiry. Requirements typically include CGPA above 2.00, attendance 80%+, valid insurance, current/upcoming enrolment, and passport valid at least 18 months.

title: Submit visa renewal
answer: Submit your original passport to the Visa Services Counter, pay the RM500 renewal processing fee, and email the passport-sized photo to iss@swinburne.edu.my. Extra documents may be requested.

title: Lost or stolen passport
answer: Make a police report, report to Visa Services, prepare RM100 for a Special Pass, and contact your embassy for passport replacement.

title: Visa cancellation
answer: Students who complete studies, withdraw, or transfer must properly cancel the current student pass and submit the required forms and passport at least 7 working days before departure.
